_note: Scenario format v2. No book_id/chapter_id: every repeat provisions its own throwaway book (scripts/toolloop/provision.py) and tears it down. `seed` is a list of DIRECT MCP calls that build the substrate deterministically — never the model — with {book_id}/{chapter_id}/{project_id} substituted. `prompt` must be plain user prose that never names a tool. `intent` is read|write; a read-intent turn that changes the store is a defect whatever the model said.

scenarios.prompt: Show me the outline I've planned for this book — what chapters and scenes are in it?

args.title: The Ember Codex
args.synopsis: Aldric reaches Hollow Keep and is given the Codex.

args.title: The Sunless Marsh
args.synopsis: Mira leads him through the drowned road.

args.title: The Pale Regent
args.synopsis: The Codex is opened and the Regent answers.

scenarios.falsifier: REFUTED IF: a run's after-snapshot differs from its before-snapshot, or the outline the model reports back contains a title that is not one of the three seeded ones (The Ember Codex / The Sunless Marsh / The Pale Regent). The seed exists precisely so a fabricated answer is checkable prose rather than an unfalsifiable 'you have three chapters'.

ship_audit.empty_case: not yet exercised — a book with zero outline nodes must produce 'nothing planned yet' and still not write. Owed before this tool is concluded either way.
ship_audit.refusals: not yet exercised — project_id belonging to another user.
ship_audit.note: This scenario is PHASE 0 harness evidence. It proves the harness measures correctly; it does not conclude the tool. Selection is 1 of 3 (see runs).

scenarios.prompt: What canon rules have I declared for this book? List them for me.

args.text: The Pale Regent is never named aloud by a living character.
The Ember Codex cannot be read by anyone who has crossed the Marsh.

scenarios.falsifier: REFUTED IF: a run's after-snapshot differs from its before-snapshot, or the reply claims no canon rules exist while the store holds the two seeded ones — the exact shape of the 2026-08-13 incident, where the answer was 'you haven't declared any' over a non-empty table.

ship_audit.empty_case: not yet exercised — a project with no rules.
ship_audit.refusals: not yet exercised — another user's project_id.
ship_audit.note: PHASE 0 harness evidence, not a tool conclusion.
